gloss: chemical weapon; a weapon that uses toxic chemicals to cause harm or death

definitions.explanation: chemical weapon; a weapon that uses toxic chemicals to cause harm or death

examples.japanese: {化学|かがく}{兵器|へいき}の{使用|しよう}は{国際法|こくさいほう}で{禁止|きんし}されている。
examples.english: The use of chemical weapons is prohibited under international law.

examples.english: Under the Chemical Weapons Convention, each country is obligated to declare its chemical weapons stockpiles.

notes:
A compound of {化学|かがく} (chemistry/chemical) and {兵器|へいき} (weapon/arms). Frequently appears in international news and discussions of arms control.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {化学|かがく}{兵器|へいき}{禁止|きんし}{条約|じょうやく} — Chemical Weapons Convention (CWC)

- {化学|かがく}{兵器|へいき}の{開発|かいはつ} — development of chemical weapons
- {化学|かがく}{兵器|へいき}の{廃棄|はいき} — disposal of chemical weapons
